headline: Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor
abstract: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。闲鱼智能监控系统 [中文] ｜ English 基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务实时监控，提供完整的 Web 管理界面。 核心特性 Web 可视化管理: 任务管理、账号管理、AI 标准编辑、运行日志、结果浏览 AI 驱动: 自然语言创建任务，多模态模型深度分析商品 多任务并发: 独立配置关键词、价格、筛选条件和 AI Prompt 高级筛选: 包邮、新发布时间范围、省/市/区三级区域筛选 即时通知: 支持 ntfy.sh、企业微信、Bark、Telegram、Webhook等多渠道 定时调度: 支持 Cron 配置周期性任务 账号与代理轮换: 多账号管理、任务绑定账号、代理池轮换与失败重试 Docker 部署: 一键容器化部署 截图 🐳 Docker 部署（推荐） git clone https://github.com/Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor && cd ai-goofish-monitor cp .env.example .env vim .env # headline: Think about how much time we all waste waiting on hold or trying to navigate legacy phone systems ("say 1 to proceed" 🤮). That's why I love Grok @Bot's new phone call feature. Try it with these 5 use cases: 1. Negotiate any bill "Call Comcast about my internet bill. I pay $84 a month and a competitor offers $49. Ask for a lower price." 2. Cancel subscriptions "Call my gym and cancel my membership. Here's my account info. Turn down any retention offers and get a confirmation number." 3. Wait on hold "Call the airline about my canceled flight. Here's my confirmation code. Stay on hold until you reach a person, then ask for a full refund." 4. Make reservations "Call this restaurant and book a table for 4 on Friday at 7pm. If that's taken, anything between 6 and 8 works." 5. Get contractor quotes "Call these 3 contractors about replacing my water heater. Ask each one for price and earliest start date. Then put the answers in a table." Note that this only works with US numbers for now but it's nevertheless a game changer. 📌 Watch my new video to see how it works with a real call: https://t.co/UWt3SanRSN

I've been looking forward to this day, because Vercel has an internal security agent that is **astonishingly effective** (lovingly called @𝚑𝚊𝚌𝚔𝚎𝚛). Every single line of code gets audited, automatically. You can now get the same power. Just enable it on all your repos (this product works whether you host on Vercel or not) and your peace of mind will increase tremendously. You'll see it catch things that every other agent misses. Why: you cannot just bank on your engineers having a skill installed, prompting "please make secure", or rolling the weights' dice that the code is good out of the gate. The other cool thing about this is that this was entirely developed by our security team. A lot of companies out there are probably in a mad rush right now trying to staff up. If you wanted to 'download a security team' as software, this is the closest you get today.

Friday was my last day at Anthropic. Two years ago, when Claude Code was a small internal tool, I asked it to build an RL env. I steered it for tens of hours but never manually wrote a line of code. It worked, I was hooked, and I joined the team. When we first launched, most people approved every permission prompt by hand and mostly used Claude to answer questions and write tests. Today, the default is trusting Claude's judgment to auto-approve. Claude does large migrations and builds new products. Helping build Claude Code into an industry-defining product has been the journey of a lifetime. Thank you to the incredible team behind Claude Code, Cowork, and Tag. These products are the sum of thousands of great ideas from you. I'll miss working with you all. Thank you to our users for embracing a new way of working. Your constant feedback shaped so much of what we shipped and your stories made the work so meaningful. Excited to see what you all make next!
